title: docs(pm-skill): area-lease — the 2026-11-15 maintainer rules
body:
Fixes #33907
Fixes #34007

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 2026-11-15 您定下的分区规则写进 pm-dispatch 的 `references/area-lease.md`:认领前三查、dev 开 PR 前自查申报、跨车道卡留道、积压即再拆区、仅呈您的选项组过独立评审且用中文、PASS 后 10 分钟内落地;按您 16:56Z「建议每区3个，你通过降低开发节约token没有意义啊」,每区恒跑 3 个 dev、空位即补,每个位子的上张 PR 进了合并队列才领下一张,等人(Tier H 或待裁)的 PR 让出位子,省 token 只靠省耗行、不减 dev;按 16:08Z 的裁决,p3 不单做、只搭同文件的 p1/p2 PR,只复审区宣布定稿的绿 head,线程 effort high;按 16:06Z「50 行内由区自审」,≤50 行的纯文本或测试 PR 由区自审落地,其余由复核线程作 ACCEPT 读,契约复核记录只在 `contract-review.md` 四面才欠;按 15:59Z「定复审席必须由另一个账号来坐 没有这个规定」,`lanes/review.md` 第 19 行去掉账号限制;删去过期的 11-14 八区示例。
- 为什么改:您说「写仓库」,这些规则此前只在 server 席位的项目工作稿里,其他车道和后续席位读不到。
- 风险与回滚:只改智能体规则文本和一行行数上限,不改产品代码、不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md` 的「区内规则」节(新规则全在此);② `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` 中 area-lease 行 59 → 71 及其裁决引注(记录 6897821873、6898023768 与认领评论 6895484790);③ `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/review.md` 第 19 行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,应见 `area-lease.md is 71 lines (ceiling 71; headroom 0)` 且退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S:受管路径仅 `.claude/**`,`scripts/pm/**` 非受管面;凭本席复核线程的 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS 记录入队)。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`, 59 lines on main → 71. The rules are written in the file's own style: short lines, ⛔ markers, and pointers to the owning references (`execution-duties.md`, `contract-review.md`, `decision-analysis.md`, `landing-operations.md`, `security-findings.md`, `review-checklist.md`, `os-dev.md`) with no restatement.

1. Pre-claim three checks, each a line in the claim comment: `Pre-claim lane:`, `Pre-claim deps:` and `Prior rulings read:` (line shape per `decision-analysis.md`). A failure, a conflict in the records, or a route that changes a door's visible behaviour beyond the card's ruling means no claim and no dev; the question goes to the seat.
2. Only option sets put to the maintainer get an independent `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review, several cards in one batch; the seat's own routing calls start no review and the seat reads the code itself. Each set carries `Prior rulings read:`, goes before development and never mid-build, in Chinese.
3. The dev self-checks the declaration lines before opening the PR, against os-dev.md's Definition of done, with BREAKING and ADR-0087 per AGENTS.md Post-Task item 3.
4. No standalone p3 (16:08Z ruling): a p3 rides only on a p1/p2 PR touching the same file, at most 5 cards per PR. At the switch to this rule, a p3 already claimed but not started is released to the queue once.
5. An analysed cross-lane card with a clear fix stays in lane even when it touches `ui/**` or `packages/spec/**`, and is reviewed by this seat. A live seat in the other lane is only notified. The line takes precedence over the clause-② line in `execution-duties.md`, the move in `lanes/spec.md` and the `--tier` hint. The hand-off set is closed: the other lane's live seat already claimed it, cloud routing, security, ADR text.
6. Each area keeps 3 dev agents running and refills a freed slot at once (16:56Z ruling, 「建议每区3个，你通过降低开发节约token没有意义啊」 · 「我要尽快处理」, record 6898023768 on #34007, superseding the 16:08Z 2-dev cap). The merge-queue gate is per slot: a slot takes its next card only once its own previous PR is in the merge queue, and until then that dev runs the PR's fix rounds. A PR waiting on a person (Tier H or a maintainer decision) frees its slot. The quota-wall pointer to `execution-duties.md` moves onto the card-folding line. The seat re-checks every area each round. A backlogged area is split again rather than given a higher per-area count.
7. A PASSed, all-green, non-governed PR lands within 10 minutes, and the area first checks for an existing landing comment so it never arms twice.

Review and cost lines:

- Self-review (16:06Z, 「50 行内由区自审」): a PR of at most 50 changed lines that edits only text or tests, declares `Clause-②: no` and touches no other contract face is self-reviewed by the area against `review-checklist.md`, the ACCEPT names the self-review, and it lands. Every other PR gets the review thread's ACCEPT read, which takes precedence over `contract-review.md`'s rule against a second agent.
- The contract record is owed only on `contract-review.md`'s four faces, and a moved head follows that file's head-move exception (`Regen-provenance:`). A clean main merge with the same patch-id keeps only the thread's ACCEPT.
- Review runs only on the green head that the area has declared final in a PR comment, with delta reviews after fixes.
- Cost: the dev's pre-push scope is os-dev.md's local verification section (derived gates, and the full dogfood battery on `!` or `(narrowing)`), pointed to rather than restated; cross-thread messages carry pointers only; threads run at effort high, and the dev's effort stays per `execution-duties.md`; tokens are saved through this line, never through fewer devs. A thread rotates at about 150k at a clean point, never mid-review, and writes its hand-over to `/mnt/project-files/SEAT/handover-AREA.md`.
- Review thread (16:00Z, 「复审车道和你这里的复审不是一个概念吗？ 你派出的任务需要审核，但未必都需要契约复审」): the seat's review threads are its PR review threads, not the review lane, and the `lanes/review.md` seat rules do not apply to them. The mode line in the file header names it 复核线程.

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/review.md` L19, per 「定复审席必须由另一个账号来坐 没有这个规定」 (15:59Z): the account restriction is removed. Independence is the record's `Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` pair with two different sessions, and any account may sit, the dispatching one included. The file stays at 21 lines.

The dated eight-area example from 2026-11-14 is deleted. The lease table on the seat post is the one record, and partitioning is re-derived every shift. Main's removal of the area-thread authorising line (PR #34000) is kept as main has it.

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `area-lease.md` row goes from main's 59 to 71, re-measured against main's 59-line file, +12 in all. It is three ordinary ruled raises:

- +8, the area-mode rules. Ruling of record: the maintainer, 2026-11-15, verbatim 「写仓库」, quoted in the body of #33907 (filing gate ③), claim comment 6895484790.
- +1, the self-review rule. Ruling of record: 「50 行内由区自审」 (16:06Z, decision card), recorded in comment 6897821873 on #34007.
- +3, the throughput and cost rules. Ruling of record: 「同意他的建议：每区先开 2 个开发代理，上一个 PR 进了合并队列再领下一张卡；不单独做 p3；只复审已经变绿、不再改的提交；线程 effort 用 high。」 (16:08Z, project chat), recorded in the same comment 6897821873.
- +0, the dev line reworded in place by 「建议每区3个，你通过降低开发节约token没有意义啊」 · 「我要尽快处理」 (16:56Z, project chat), recorded in comment 6898023768 on #34007.

The maintainer's words for each card rule, verbatim as #33907 quotes them:

- Rule 1: 「已经开工了，退回的原因是什么？你就是总指挥啊」
- Rule 2: 「你让我选的都用 fable 评审过吗？应该用中文和我沟通」 · 「之前选过的也再评审一遍」
- Rule 4: 「yes」 (to the coordinator's proposal), since superseded by 「不单独做 p3」
- Rule 5: 「已经分析了一轮，换车道的价值大吗？…协调之后继续处理」 · 「复审也是一样的流程，为什么要对方车道复审？如果车道有人在线，只需要通知他就可以。」
- Rule 6: 「任务很多啊，你应该监督座位全速开发」 · 「比如增加分区」, with the per-area count since set by 「建议每区3个」

Three of these are carried inline in the file where they are the operative wording: 「比如增加分区」, 「如果车道有人在线，只需要通知他就可以。」 and 「应该用中文和我沟通」. The rest live here as provenance, under the line budget. In the file, the review is named by its tier constant rather than a model name.

SKILL.md is untouched: its 阶段细则索引 already lists `references/area-lease.md`.

## Tests

No runtime code changed and no tested behaviour moved, so there is no ablation. `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs --self-test` passes 164 cases. No other test file names the script.

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` publish nothing from any package.
- The card's claim carries no `Clause-②:` or `Metadata-protocol:` lines, so none are copied here.
- Round history: first round 2db5497f; patch round 3fbadcf6 (「要同步更新 skills」, review-c S1–S3, record 6896328536); third round 4a5035d8 (main merge with #33943, the 15:59Z, 16:00Z, 16:06Z and 16:08Z rulings; review-c PASS, record 6897812829); fourth round ff06482b (main merge with PR #34000 at ace5ce66, review-c S4–S6 and N5–N8, then the 16:56Z dev-line ruling).
